Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the time last week. As discussed, we'd like to schedule a focused architecture review to walk through: pool sizing assumptions, autoscale policies and latency SLOs, canary rollout strategy, and isolation/fallback options for mixed-tenant bursts.

Proposed agenda (attached): agenda-dedicated-pool-review.pdf
- sizing snapshot & traffic profile (10m)
- autoscale windows and cooldowns (10m)
- canary / canary-to-ga rollout plan (15m)
- isolation and failover (15m)
- Q&A / next steps (10m)

Available windows (PT):
- Wed Sep 22, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Sep 22, 13:00–14:00
- Thu Sep 23, 09:00–10:00

Please let us know which works for you and if procurement/ops should join — I copied Kim and Karthik for capacity/ops detail. Attached: pool-sizing-snapshot.xlsx and canary-plan-summary.md.

Cheers,
Marissa
